people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”
translations.bsb: “Micah has done this and that for me,” he replied, “and he has hired me to be his priest.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Thus and thus hath Micah dealt with me, and he hath hired me, and I am become his priest.
